# Kinocut

> Kinocut is a remote video-editing subscription. Creators and teams send footage and receive a finished cut for one flat monthly fee.

Kinocut edits YouTube, shorts, podcasts, interviews, vlogs, and ads. One request is active at a time. The queue can hold more, and the next request starts when the current cut is approved, or after 3 business days of silence. Cancel anytime. The client owns the final files.

## Plans

Prices are in US dollars per month. Visitors in Nigeria are shown and charged the naira equivalent at the daily rate.

- Spark: $499 per month. Short-form up to 60 seconds. Interviews and vlogs up to 5 minutes. Average short-form turnaround is 48 hours. Long-form is 4 business days. 1 revision round.
- Momentum: $999 per month. Short-form up to 90 seconds. Interviews, vlogs, YouTube, and demos up to 15 minutes. Long-form is 3 business days. 2 revision rounds.
- Studio: $2,499 per month. Interviews, vlogs, YouTube, and demos up to 20 minutes. Custom motion graphics up to 30 seconds. Short-form and long-form average 48 hours. 2 revision rounds, plus free minor tweaks. Explainers are quoted separately, with a 10% discount.

A request is one finished video plus up to 3 resizes. Up to 5 clips from one source count as one request. Shoots, scripting, voiceover talent, 3D, and music outside the licensed library are not included.

## How it works

1. Subscribe to one plan.
2. Send a Google Drive, Dropbox, Frame.io, or WeTransfer link with a short brief.
3. Receive the finished cut, usually within 48 hours for short-form once the brief and footage are complete.
